entries.title: Surviving the Abyss
entries.definitive_edition: Surviving the Abyss on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Surviving the Abyss is a deep-sea survival colony builder from Rocket Flair Studios and Paradox Arc. Its Windows Early Access release began January 17, 2023, while the full release date is November 5, 2024, with Windows system requirements. No console, Mac, or Linux release exists. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it is the only platform and current full-release path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. Treat the January 2023 build as Early Access history, not the archive target.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive-edition split was found; use the full-release Steam build rather than an old Early Access branch.
